scope.lane: historical self-model grounding repair response after identity/capability drift

sources.claim: Removed SystemRealityLayer injection from idle thoughts after 67% context/prompt-leak rejection rate; post-fix 0% in reported 30min idle run.

sources.title: live_bugs.txt
sources.claim: Later V25 tests still found self-knowledge/tool-awareness staleness including wrong model size and stale AURA terminology.

findings.claim: SystemRealityLayer was described as dynamically probed ground truth, but dynamic probing covered hardware only. Software stack, service topology and creator/user identity were hard-coded module constants.
findings.implication: A component named or treated as ground truth is not authoritative merely by placement or naming. Every field requires per-field provenance, freshness and update semantics.

findings.claim: The Ego Governor used post-generation regex categories for wrong model/architecture/GPU/infrastructure and appended corrections from SystemRealityLayer facts.
findings.implication: Post-generation correction can be a defense-in-depth layer, but it is downstream of generation and inherits any staleness/errors of its fact store. It cannot be the sole self-model consistency mechanism.

findings.claim: Injecting SystemRealityLayer into idle-thought prompts caused a reported 67% rejection rate due to verbatim [REALITY] prompt leakage; removing that injection plus leak-regex handling produced a reported 0% rejection rate in the subsequent 30-minute idle test.
findings.implication: Grounding payloads can become behavioral contaminants when broadcast indiscriminately. Authority/facts should be retrieved or projected only when causally relevant and should not be exposed as a large prompt block to every cognitive loop.

findings.claim: Later V25 evaluation still recorded wrong model self-knowledge and stale AURA terminology, so the SystemRealityLayer/Ego-Governor repair did not eliminate self-model staleness across the system lifecycle.
findings.implication: The durable fix is semantic single-authority state with compiled projections and runtime receipts, not another manually maintained mirror plus regex correction.

findings.claim: Self-model grounding should be demand-shaped: canonical identity is immutable/versioned; live capabilities/topology are observed with timestamps; derived subjective state is separate; prompts receive only task-relevant projections. A validator checks claims against the same typed state rather than a second constant table.
findings.falsifier: A simpler duplicated-static-fact design with no typed authority/freshness layer matches or outperforms the proposed design under topology/model churn, stale-cache injection, prompt-leak and capability-denial regression tests.

frank: Replace RealityLayer-style mixed static/dynamic fact bags with per-field authority/freshness semantics and one semantic source.
claycode: Make projection/retrieval of self-model facts typed and context-scoped; validation must consume the same authoritative state object.
unifieddb: Store observed topology/model/capability facts with observed_at, source, version and stale/superseded state.
gwt: Do not globally broadcast large identity/reality blocks; test selective access versus global injection for leakage and interference.
harness: Add topology/model churn tests, stale constant injection, prompt-leak measurement and post-generation-validator stale-source tests.
claygraph: Represent fact provenance and supersession explicitly; ground-truth label is metadata only unless backed by authority evidence.
emergenz: Treat reduced confabulation from injected fact blocks as grounding performance, not evidence of emergence or self-awareness.
hyperposition: Maintain conflicting/current/stale self-model candidates until evidence selects or supersedes them instead of forcing a single stale constant.

historical_earned_work.reason: Useful repair/failure lineage, but likely overlaps previously mapped state/identity and harness work; row-level dedup required.

next_tests: Topology churn replay: change model/service topology, leave stale mirrors intentionally, and verify authoritative projections update while old claims become SUPERSEDED/STALE.
Prompt contamination test: compare global reality-block broadcast, task-scoped retrieval and structured side-channel validation on leakage/rejection/context cost.
Validator common-source test: corrupt a downstream mirror and verify both generation projection and validator remain consistent because neither owns separate truth constants.
blockers: Current GitHub connector still provides no recursive Project-Frankenstein tree/archive/clone read. Directory fetch at frozen ref was rejected as directory-not-file.
No exact repository-wide coverage or Level-0 PASS is claimed.
